title: Telefonie SMS Message
description: Represents an SMS or MMS message sent or received through the Telefonie SMS API.

status.description: Current delivery status of the message

direction.description: Whether the message is inbound or outbound

from.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format

num_segments.description: Number of SMS segments used (long messages may span multiple segments)

media_url.description: URLs of media files attached to an MMS message

date_created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message resource was created

date_sent.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message was dispatched

date_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message resource was last updated

error_code.description: Telefonie error code if the message failed

error_message.description: Human-readable error description if the message failed
